summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Avantis Responsible International Equity ETF (AVSD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in companies of all market capitalizations in developed markets outside of the US. Holdings are screened for multiple ESG metrics and selected based on fundamental criteria AVSD was launched on Mar 15, 2022 and is issued by American Century Investments.

holdings.infoBox: AVSD is an equity ETF with a total of 2079 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 1.19%, HSBC Holdings at 1.11%, Roche Holding AG at 1.05%, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group at 0.82%, and Royal Bank of Canada at 0.80%.
